title: ApprovalRecords
description: Task 004 foundation: four separate approval gates. Automated tests, scientific review, notebook educational review, and owner approval are distinct records. Owner approval is bound to a specific versionHash and stored separately; PR merge, build success, and publishing are never owner approval.

VersionHashScope.description: Authoritative scope for versionHash. Includes every content-affecting input; excludes approval records themselves so recording approval never changes the approved version.

includes.description: Lesson data, stages, notebook, coverage matrix, source records, images, figures, equations.
